columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: ACTION_CODE
columns.description: Allows source system to specify a particular operation (insert, update, etc) for a row. Bulk import process will perform the operation based on this code.

columns.name: INTERNAL_ACTION_CODE
columns.description: Indicates the action of insert or update based on matching outcome.

columns.name: INTERNAL_OSR_OVN
columns.description: To handle optimistic locking on the object that is being updated.  The column is used for storing Object Version Number from Fusion base table. The number is compared at the start and end of transaction to detect if another session has changed the row since it was queried.

columns.name: ORIG_SYSTEM_REF_ID
columns.description: Primary key of the existing OS+OSR combination.

columns.name: ORIG_SYSTEM
columns.description: Orig system that is to be newly created or updated if it exists already.

columns.name: ORIG_SYSTEM_REFERENCE

columns.name: OWNER_TABLE_NAME
columns.description: Stores base table name.

columns.name: EXISTING_OWNER_TABLE_ID
columns.description: To be provided in case of INSERT.  This is the referenced owner_table_id or primary key that already exists in the entity base table.

columns.name: EXISTING_ORIG_SYSTEM
columns.description: To be provided in case of INSERT.  This is the referenced orig system that already exists in the OSR base table.

columns.name: EXISTING_ORIG_SYSTEM_REFERENCE
columns.description: To be provided in case of INSERT.  This is the referenced orig system reference that already exists in the OSR base table.

columns.name: REASON_CODE
